title: Optical Neural Networks from Coherent Transient Dynamics in Waveguide QED
summary: Optical neural networks promise ultrafast, low-energy information processing by performing computation directly with photons. Current implementations, however, are largely restricted to steady-state operation and rely on high-latency electro-optical conversion for nonlinear activation. To address these limitations, we propose an all-optical fully connected neural network architecture in which the basic neuronal functions are realized by coherent transient quantum dynamics. Within this framework, phase-tunable nonlocal interference in a giant cavity implements programmable synaptic weights;…
